pairs.name: Arc Warden
pairs.reason: Arc kites Gyro with Spark Wraiths and constant slow. His Tempest Double safely harasses from range, while Gyro can't reach or burst him before being chipped down.

pairs.name: Lifestealer
pairs.reason: Lifestealer shrugs off Gyro’s magic damage with Rage. He can also infest and burst Gyro in fights, taking advantage of Gyro’s low armor and lack of hard disables.

pairs.name: Viper
pairs.reason: Viper’s Nethertoxin shuts down Flak Cannon by disabling passives. His poison and Break effects reduce Gyro’s ability to sustain or kite.

pairs.name: Ancient Apparition
pairs.reason: Ice Blast nullifies Gyro’s healing from Satanic and other regen sources. AA's long-range harass also punishes Gyro’s slow early movement.

pairs.name: Razor
pairs.reason: Razor drains Gyro’s damage mid-fight with Static Link, making Flak Cannon almost useless. Razor also tanks through magical burst and out-sustains in lane.

pairs.name: Juggernaut
pairs.reason: Juggernaut can Blade Fury through all of Gyro’s early-game magic. Omnislash cuts down Gyro, who has no strong escape or disable to stop it.

pairs.name: Keeper of the Light
pairs.reason: Blinding Light causes Gyro’s Flak Cannon attacks to miss. KotL’s high mobility and magic burst disrupt Gyro’s teamfight contribution.

pairs.name: Venomancer
pairs.reason: Venomancer kites Gyro with slows .Poison Nova combined with other spells from venomancer allies pressure and makes Gyro’s low HP pool a liability in prolonged fights.

pairs.name: Shadow Demon
pairs.reason: Disruption saves Gyro’s targets from Rocket Barrage or Homing Missile. He can also create illusions that scale better than Gyro in some cases.
